rules.statement: Parole evidence is admissible to prove a constructive trust and the transferor's lack of intent to pass beneficial interest in the property.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) The Prevention of Frauds Ordinance and Section 92 of the Evidence Ordinance do not bar parole evidence to prove a constructive trust and that the transferor did not intend to pass the beneficial interest in the property. (ii) Extrinsic evidence to prove attendant circumstances can be properly be received in evidence to prove a resulting trust

rules.statement: Extrinsic evidence may be admitted to establish the surrounding circumstances relevant to proving a resulting trust.
